title: Document the round trip: tools, concepts walkthrough, README, glossary
description:
## Intent
Document the way back from the DAW.

## Scope
- `docs/tools.md` (DAW sidecars): `apricity import --markers`, `--sample`, `--beat-offset`, `--dry-run`, `--reset-markers`, library mode; how to save markers in the DAW (the clip view's Save button, or drag the clip to the browser for an `.alc`).
- `docs/concepts.md`: a short "Round trip with the DAW" walkthrough (export → correct → import → compile), with the M5 diagram.
- README: the import line in "Making music"; `docs/glossary.md` "import".

## Verify
Every command in the walkthrough runs as written against the fixtures; docs render in the Docs tab.

Commit: `docs(<this id>): importing warp markers from the DAW`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
